scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:workspace && npm run test --workspace=apps/api -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.db:deploy: npm exec --workspace=apps/api -- prisma migrate deploy --config prisma7.config.ts
